title: PCK-ADOPT with H = the logical catalog fn-sca-load-held-rows (books/catalog-availability-owner-load.lisp:87; keyed form served-catalog-owner-keyed.lisp:20, equal by fn-sca-load-held-rows-keyed-is-load-held-rows) builds from a cleared catalog over the records of the store opened from prefix (arguments as in owner-recovery-retain.lisp:226-232). Intended statement: (implies (and (fn-cat-rowsp H) (fn-pck-carriedp H) (equal H (fn-pck-held-of-prefix configs prefix))) <the PCK-ADOPT conclusion>), i.e. (equal (fn-crow-of-pages (fn-pck-cat-pages H)) (fn-pck-crow-rows (fn-pck-held-of-prefix configs prefix))), with fn-pck-held-of-prefix the fn-cat$a value of that load.
